articles.content:
You’ll find countless deals on Black Friday, but our editors have narrowed the list down to the very few worth your time

Visit our ultimate guide to Black Friday for more deals, carefully vetted and curated by Filter US editors

Some Black Friday sales are modest markdowns not worth your time, while others will save you hundreds on the buy-it-for-life mattress or vacuum cleaner you’ve been considering.

To cut through the noise, our expert product reviewers judged thousands of Black Friday discounts across home, tech, kitchen, fashion and more. Here are the ones we’d grab, on products we’ve personally tested and love.

We test products here at the Filter US and handpicked these deals. You can learn more about us at the bottom of the list. Products marked ( sold out ) are out of stock or no longer discounted. All prices are current at the time of publication. We’ll update our guides throughout Black Friday.

Everyone always needs more food storage containers (nothing makes you understand that better than Thanksgiving) and this Rubbermaid set once passed a drop test I conducted with flying colors. These sturdy containers seal well, and come in a variety of convenient sizes for sauce and leftover storage. Replace those old, weathered plastic containers at a serious discount. Emily Johnson

$23 $30 at Amazon While the Stanley cup is great for encouraging hydration at home or by your desk, it’s not easy to take on the road. Owala makes my favorite portable water bottle: Its design is simply unparalleled. The opening at the top of the water bottle functions seamlessly as both a sippable option and as a straw. This water bottle has never leaked on me, it feels pleasant in hand, and I want it in every fun color it comes in. Emily Johnson

That oven isn’t the only deal you can score at Our Place, which is offering up to 45% off sitewide. These stylish glasses come in three fun colors (in addition to the classic clear version) and are conveniently stackable. And – as I can attest to – are durable even if you have a slippery hand after a negroni or two. Emily Johnson

In my review , I wrote that this indulgent, self-heating ceramic mug “ruined all other mugs for me.” Now 20% off, this handsome ceramic cup keeps drinks toasty at 130F, while its warming pad doubles as a wireless phone charger. It hasn’t left my work-from-home station since the chilly weather has set in. Karen Yuan

I own Material’s steak knife set at home and has put these knives through the ringer of pork chops, dense starchy vegetables and, of course, steaks. They are sharp, precise and balanced. They offer a subtle stylishness that’s also neutral and universally appealing. Snag them for 20% off now. Emily Johnson

All-Clad is the original creator of bonded stainless steel cookware – and it is an enduring and beloved classic for a reason. Its cookware heats evenly and, with proper care, will last a lifetime. In the leadup to this Black Friday, you can get a 10-piece set featuring 8in and 10in fry pans, 2qt and 4qt saucepans with lids, a 4qt saute pan with a lid, and an 8qt stockpot with a lid, for $200 off. It’s still spendy, but it’s an investment that will pay dividends for ever. Emily Johnson

After spending my summer cooking with tinned fish, I named Fishwife’s options as some of the best. I used its soy ginger tuna to make onigiri and the chimichurri trout to craft an artful snack plate. If you’re beginning your tinned fish journey, its variety pack has both of those cans at 20% off. Lauren Gould

If you’re working with a smaller space and can’t accommodate a whole 10-piece cookware set, opt for this set of two stellar stainless-steel pans for $150 off. Both pans feature 5-ply bonding that makes for a combination of long-lasting sturdiness and even heating. The 8.5in size is excellent for soft scrambled eggs for one or two, while the 10.5in will come in handy for a whole host of standard cooking tasks, like caramelizing onions, browning chicken cutlets and whisking creamy pan sauces. Emily Johnson

Zojirushi is the central player in the rice cooker game for a reason: their precision heating tech is unrivaled and leads to fluffy, perfectly-cooked grains every time. Upgrade this staple appliance for over a $100 discount this Black Friday. Emily Johnson

A friend keeps ice cube trays full of caramelized onions in the freezer, ready to pop into soups, sandwiches, pastas and grain bowls for easy depth of flavor. So I bought these Anytime Freezer Trays for expressly that purpose and they’ve changed my meal-prep game: the rounded shape and silicone material make for easy removal. Plus, there’s no polluting my ice cube trays with onion flavor. I have instant flavor boosters at the ready at all times. Get them for 22% off now. Emily Johnson

We’re huge fans of Anyday’s colorful, leak-resistant silicone containers, which make storing and reheating leftovers a breeze. They’re microwave-, freezer- and dishwasher-safe, and this six-pack is now at its lowest price ever. Read our full rave review . Karen Yuan

In our review of Magnifique’s combo air fryer , we loved its glass construction, which does away with the usual nonstick-coated basket. This handsome standalone air fryer uses the same appealing materials, and at $128, it’s enjoying its biggest sale since launch. Karen Yuan

Our editors love these stretchy silicone lids for covering everything from bowls of soup and salad to opened drink cans. They’re durable, safe to pop in the dishwasher and endlessly useful. At 35% off, now’s a great time to stock up (right before the holiday leftover crush). Karen Yuan

This cult favorite pink paste is a superhero for tackling stubborn kitchen grime, from greasy stovetops to stained sinks. It’ll get at your bathroom grout, too. At just $3, it’s a satisfyingly cheap cleaning upgrade. Karen Yuan

We love a Le Creuset deal, especially when it involves this gorgeous lavender-hued Dutch oven. It’s perfect for searing, braising and simmering, and Sur La Table’s exclusive Provence shade is particularly pretty. It makes a great gift, too. Karen Yuan

On a cold, dreary day, I like lighting Flamingo Estate’s Green Goddess candle in my kitchen, which instantly recalls a summery vegetable garden. It smells strongly of fresh mint, rounded out by notes of basil, sweet peas and even bell pepper. It also has an incredible throw – meaning how far and strongly a fragrance travels – filling my entire apartment from the kitchen. Fifty-four dollars is still a lot, but this “bougie candle” (as inscribed on the label) is one of the very best. Karen Yuan

Wood is my favorite material for cutting boards, but I like to have a few low-maintenance, lightweight options around as supplements. These Material Free Boards are made out of a plant-based alternative to plastic, but still offer the same convenience. We named it best for raw meat in our review, and you can throw them in the dishwasher. Get a couple in their fun colorways for 25% off now. Emily Johnson

You probably know by now: Vitamix blenders are the best in the business . This thing boasts a two-horsepower motor that can crush nuts into milk or butter and pulverise ice into shreds for frozen drinks. In my years of using this blender, I’ve found the 5200 is the best model the brand makes, with plenty of power, variable speed and a 64-ounce container that’s optimal for most blending jobs. Score this $200 off deal and enjoy creamy soups for years to come. Emily Johnson

Every home cook dreams of owning a KitchenAid stand mixer, and this holiday season you can score the brand’s Artisan series tilt-head classic for $100 off. Snag it as a gift for the college grad setting up a new home, or the relative who suddenly got into baking this year. Emily Johnson

Breville makes espresso machines for discerning coffee lovers who may not want to go the full lengths of nerding out. The machines feature automations that make pulling a velvety, delicious shot fool-proof even for beginners. It’s the perfect gift for someone who has resolved to cut down their coffee shop trips this year - this thing pays for itself quickly, especially at a $200 discount this Black Friday. Emily Johnson

Ninja makes air fryers with more bells and whistles , but I like this simple basket-style model; it’s easy to operate right out of the box, and its powerful convection fan has always given me crispy fries and vegetables. Plus, it toasts bread and reheats pizza with aplomb. It’s the perfect size for cooking for one or two people - just be mindful to not overload the basket, since each food item needs space to allow the hot air circulation to work its crisping magic. Emily Johnson

Over years of testing sous vide machines, I’ve found that the Joule boasts the very best accuracy — which is the name of the game with sous vide. I love its streamlined design and while I’m often skeptical of appliances that link to smart phone apps, this one is genuinely useful: It features helpful temperature and cooking guides and offers convenient remote operation. Emily Johnson

This is an absolute cornucopia of holiday treats. The lavish spread feeds 12 to 15 with artisan cheeses, truffle salami, chorizo, candied nuts, dried fruits, chocolates, crackers, and four decadent baked bries. For Black Friday, you can get $50 off plus free honeycomb. (If you have leftovers, our editors love these charcuterie board-friendly storage containers , though they aren’t on sale.) Karen Yuan

Instant’s Duo represents its most classic multi-cooker model - and it’s my favorite after using nearly every model in the line - with all of the features you want in an electric multi-cooker and nothing more. Its settings include pressure cooking, slow cooking, rice cooking, yogurt making, steaming, sautéing and warming. You can get one for just $60 on Amazon right now, just in time for cozy braising and stewing season. Emily Johnson

Every home cook needs a good 3qt saucepan for making small batches of soup, individual portions of mac and cheese, and many, many sauces. Misen’s 3qt saucier features gently sloped sides, which means that a whisk can easily reach into the corners of a pan for a perfectly emulsified pan sauce. It boasts 5-ply stainless steel construction for sturdiness and even heating, and comes with a lid. Get it for 25% off on Black Friday. Emily Johnson

I’ve tested chef’s knives for years, and have long appreciated Misen’s balanced and fairly priced option – and now it’s available for an even more reasonable 25% off. This is a great knife if you want to strike a balance between the heft of a German-style knife and the easily maneuverable precision of a Japanese knife. Emily Johnson

I also recommended a $100 Cuisinart air fryer/toaster oven , and I stand by that budget pick with serious versatility and crisping power. For those looking to upgrade, Breville’s countertop ovens are expensive but unmatched. This one dehydrates, air fries (AKA cooks with convection), broils and does regular roasting beautifully. You can cook a whole dinner in it, or simply make an evenly-browned piece of toast. Emily Johnson

Fly By Jing’s condiments make perfect stocking stuffers for anyone on your list who loves to cook. This sampler gift set features three chili crisps: the brand’s original hot and numbing blend, one that’s extra spicy and one that emphasizes umami and texture (AKA less chili, more crunch). You also get a chili sauce that’s sweet, tangy and spicy, inspired by Zhong dumplings, popular in Chengdu. Emily Johnson

I love this Ninja air fryer , but I also think that a combined air fryer and toaster oven is better bang for your buck and offers more versatility. This Cuisinart has performed consistently in my years of testing air fryers and convection toaster ovens, with optimal hot air circulation for even cooking and crispy edges. The larger capacity of the toaster oven means it’s better for larger families - it’s even possible to roast a whole chicken in this guy. Emily Johnson

SMEG’s retro futurist design adds whimsy to any kitchen, but this kettle isn’t all good looks. It boasts 1400 watts of power and can boil water in four minutes or less. It’s comfortable to hold and steady to pour from. This is a great all-around kettle for getting a head start on boiling water for pasta, making tea or hot cocoa, cleaning a sink drain, and preheating mugs. Emily Johnson

Say what you want about the Stanley cup trend, which has largely come and gone anyway, but anything that promotes hydration can’t be all that bad. The cup is available at a hefty discount in all kinds of fun colors right now - I love the cheery daffodil - so snag a few for the people on your list who need to drink more water (that’s probably all of them). Emily Johnson

This drip coffee maker is beloved by coffee snobs and professionals the world over thanks to its superior shower head design, which distributes hot water evenly over the coffee grounds. This leads to superior flavor extraction and a balanced cup. I love its chic industrial look and all of the color options. As with the Stanley cup , I’m coveting the butter yellow - a pattern is emerging here. Emily Johnson

Coffee nerds, this is the kettle for you. If you make pour-over, Stagg’s gooseneck kettle allows you to delicately and evenly disperse water over the grounds for a balanced and flavorful extraction. It has precise temperature controls and has no plastic touching the hot water. Yes, it’s a splurge even at a deal, but this kettle is the very best of its kind and will make a noticeable difference in the quality of your morning brew. Emily Johnson

I’m a big fan of the sleek design on Zwilling’s Enfinigy line (I also own the personal blender). But that sleek look would be nothing if this toaster didn’t produce evenly-browned, golden slices of bread. Luckily it does just that. In a world full of multi-use, souped-up appliances, sometimes you just want a simple thing that will toast bread well. This is a great option, at a great discount. Emily Johnson

Don’t buy the Ooni as a Christmas gift for anyone who isn’t willing to commit the hours to learning how to finesse the pizza from the oven to the peel. For someone who wants to nerd out, though, this is the deal of the century on a piece of equipment that has made all of my outdoor summer parties infinitely better and more delicious. Ooni also makes one of our favorite indoor pizza ovens , the Volt 2, currently 20% off . Emily Johnson

In my experience testing air purifiers , people are often surprised by the cost of an air purifier big enough to purify a whole floor of a house – it’s often up to triple the price of a one-room purifier. That’s why this sale on the Coway 250S I’ve tested previously caught my eye. It can cover 1,860 sq ft, and has an easily accessible and cleanable pre-filter mesh, the part that catches large debris like pet hair. Its activated carbon filter helps remove odors, and a Hepa filter reduces fine particulates. Jon Chan

Washer-dryer combos have come a long way in the past few years. This GE model is the prime example. If you have a water hookup, a drain pipe and a 120V outlet, you can do laundry. No exhaust vent needed. When we spent hands-on time with this machine, we enjoyed the automatic detergent dispenser, the Microban-injected gasket that prevents odors, and the 4.8-cubic-ft capacity. Jon Chan

So you want the ergonomic convenience of an upright vacuum while cleaning the floor, but hate cleaning the stairs with it? The Shark Vertex Lift-Away NV752 can be lifted off its wheeled base and used with a hose, allowing you to more easily clean tight spaces like your car and the stairs. The brush head can clean hardwood and carpet, and you can select between these two modes with a flick of a switch on the handle. We cleaned with this system before and found it great at removing debris, fine dust and pet hair. Jon Chan

Turn your pilling sweaters from bleak to chic with this battery-powered fabric shaver. Keeping your clothing in good condition for longer is a great way to save money and reduce waste. Aside from the price, we also like that shavings are stored in an easily emptied chamber. Jon Chan

Bubble blankets are huge on social media. One issue is that they tend to be super expensive. However, our investigations show that Bedsure makes a throw that is just as soft and cozy as the high-end brands at a fraction of the cost. This throw isn’t quite large enough for a bed, but perfect for cuddling on the couch. Jon Chan

Many quality tool companies, like DeWalt, often sell drills without a battery. This deal bundle comes with a battery that’s swappable, giving access to the whole DeWalt cordless collection. Jon Chan

Tech deals tend to get the spotlight on Black Friday, but it’s also a good time to stock up on pantry items and household essentials. Toilet paper might not be glamorous, but this is a chance to get the premium stuff for the same price as its cheaper peers. Jon Chan

This robot vacuum-mop combo comes with a detachable carpet cleaner. Our reviewer found it to be a secret weapon against spills and stains . The robot self-cleans and has the ability to avoid common obstacles like socks. However, the carpet cleaner is the star, able to remove tea, coffee and red wine from low-pile carpet instantly. Best of all, the Eufy E28 is at the lowest price we’ve ever seen. Jon Chan

When it comes to air purifiers, one big pain point is replacing the expensive filters. The Shark NeverChange only needs a new one every five years, based on running 12 hours a day. It also has a built-in nebulizer that emits a Febreze-like scent. Personally, we’d rely on the carbon filter to remove odors, as the nebulizer is a bit much for us, but your mileage may vary. Jon Chan

How do you know when you’ve missed a spot? The Dyson V15 Detect uses an angled green laser that illuminates fine dust and dirt on hardwood floors. A swappable battery eliminates a common point of failure for many cordless vacuums. Filter US editor Jeffrey Van Camp has had his for two years and swears by it. Six-hundred dollars is about the floor for its pricing over the past few years. Jon Chan

This small-but-mighty carpet cleaner has a cult following, and after using it, we can see why. It’s powerful for its exceptionally compact size, and easy to use. When you’re done the hose wraps around the Little Green’s body, and it stands just over 12in tall, making it easy to store in the back of a closet, under a sink or even in a car trunk. Jon Chan

This capacious French door fridge is perfect for anyone who loves hosting. The FlexZone drawer is a separate area with independent temperature controls that can be set to anywhere from extra cold for additional freezer space to just chilly enough for a refreshing drink. Speaking of drinks, it can also produce spherical ice, ideal for keeping cocktails cold without watering them down, and a built-in water pitcher that refills itself with filtered water. Jon Chan

If you sit working most of the day, investing in an ergonomic office chair is 100% worth it. Aeron is the pinnacle of chair technology. Everything from the armrests, seat angle and spine support are adjustable to nearly every body type. Plus, the mesh backing helps prevent heat buildup. Jon Chan

Slightly cheaper per battery than on Amazon. Batteries are a staple, especially since so many holiday gifts don’t include them. Now is the best time to stock up and save a little money. Just think of all the things in your house that will need a change in AA batteries in the coming year. Jon Chan

Everyone owns towels, but these exceptionally plush ones are a great way to add a little luxury to your daily routine. When I tested 16 different models to find the best bath towels , I praised these for their lightweight feel and high absorbency. Giving them as a gift? They come in 28 different colors, and for $16 you can personalize them with a monogram. Jon Chan

Laundry detergent sheets are a no-mess way to travel with detergent, conveniently pre-measured, and great for people who lack the hand strength to pour liquid detergent. Hey Sunday makes our favorite detergent sheets because they‘re safe to hand wash and can powerfully remove stains. Jon Chan

Stop putting off organizing your garage or basement with this exceptionally low price on heavy-duty steel shelving from Lowe’s. Powder coating and smooth, machined edges prevent the unit from rusting and from scratching boxes (or your hands). In our experience, a boltless design translates to a quick assembly and allows you to adjust the height of all five shelves without much hassle. Jon Chan

One of the worst things about an alarm clock is how … alarming they can be. The Loftie solves this problem by waking you up in two phases. First, it plays gentle-sounding music to prime you, then ramps up to wake-up tones. You can also set it to block distracting apps when your phone is nearby. You can even set the clock itself to be less distracting by dimming it to black at night. It’s backed by so much sleep science that it’s HSA-eligible. Jon Chan

Just look at how much this cat loves this mattress topper ! We love it for its luxurious feel and the baffle-box design that prevents bunching. If you’re looking for an affordable way to make your mattress softer and cozier, check out this mattress topper for 25% off. Jon Chan

If you’re on the fence about weighted blankets, you should check out the YnM 15-Pound. It’s not the most luxurious, but it is super affordable. It’s filled with glass beads that help create a cooling effect, which is great if you’re a hot sleeper. The YnM is now at one of the lowest prices we’ve ever seen, so try it if you’re curious about how a weighted blanket might improve your sleep . Jon Chan

Percale is a weave known for its crisp and cooling feel. However, when you first get it, the sheets can feel a bit too stiff. Brooklinen solves this problem by prewashing them to break down the fibers so they are a little softer to the touch. Our experience with the brand tells us that you can expect high-quality bedding made from long-staple cotton with double stitching, so it’s rare to see such a steep discount. Jon Chan

When I tested the Purple Harmony Pillow , I really liked how supportive yet soft it was. I also liked how its raised texture helped keep my face from getting all sweaty at night. My one main issue was how expensive it was. However, this Black Friday, you can save big on this space-age pillow. Jon Chan

Based on my testing, the Beckham Hotel Collection Pillows provide an excellent value . They’re super soft, fluffy and provide a cooling effect. If you’re trying to recapture that feeling of snuggling in at a five-star hotel, these pillows are the ticket. Jon Chan

Spare your holiday guests your lumpy couch and give them the dignity of an air mattress on the floor. The Intex Dura-Beam Deluxe is a great choice because it’s super affordable and comes with its own built-in pump. I’ve personally seen this air mattress survive an elbow drop from a grown man. Jon Chan

In our modern world, there is often too much light to get a good night’s sleep. That’s where a good pair of blackout curtains come in. The Amazon Basic Blackout Curtains aren’t super fancy, but then again, you just need fabric thick enough to block out light. I’ve seen these curtains block out street and workshop lights. Jon Chan

It can be a hassle to sleep on planes, trains and automobiles. The Infinity Pillow makes it a little easier. It’s a cross between a scarf and a snap bracelet, locking into place in a variety of positions. We like the fact that it’s made from breathable material, so it doesn’t get too hot. Jon Chan

According to the Sleep Foundation, lavender and chamomile are among the best essential oils to promote sleep. This Deep Sleep Pillow Spray makes it easy to apply to your sleep routine. There are no messy bottles or greasy pipettes to deal with. At the very least, you can impart a pleasant scent to your pillow. Jon Chan

$111 $148 at Amazon (for Amazon Prime members) , $140 $164 at Cozy Earth

A luxurious bath robe is a great way to prepare your body for slumber. Cozy Earth makes a bath robe that’s worth every penny. Our reviewer said it was ideal for “ robe rotting ”. That’s a stellar endorsement if we’ve ever heard one. But if that’s not enough, you may be interested in the no-twist design or warranty against pilling. Jon Chan

This Mzoo is the top pick in our best sleep masks guide. Filter reviewer Juno DeMelo called it “the Goldilocks of masks”, noting it effectively blocked light without slipping throughout the night. Lauren Gould

These earplugs were one of our top recommendations for achieving a better night’s rest. We love their comfortable fit and that they come in four sizes to accommodate multiple ear shapes. Lauren Gould

This long-sleeve bamboo pajama set was one of our favorite items in our guide to the best and worst items from the buzzy internet brand. Our writer Marissa Miller appreciated the viscose bamboo fabric that “provides comforting coverage without overheating the body”. Lauren Gould

Bluetooth sleep masks block light while playing a soundtrack of your choice, whether it’s white noise or an audiobook. Reviewer Juno DeMelo slept with four popular models in our best Bluetooth sleep masks guide and left impressed by the Manta’s design. “Slidable tabs on either side of the strap make it easy to adjust the position of the speakers, and you can also adjust the position of the eye cups,” she wrote. Lauren Gould

After rigorously testing to find the best pillows , reviewer Jon Chan awarded the Coop Adjustable Pillow with our best overall award. It comes with memory foam cubes to adjust to your liking, and its medium firmness will suit most sleepers. It’s also beloved by our writer Kori Perten, who remained loyal to Coop’s adjustable model after testing other options from Coop . Lauren Gould

Made with organic cotton, wool and latex instead of synthetic foams, the Naturepedic Serenade offers supportive, breathable comfort without that chemical mattress smell. After testing it for a month , our reviewer praised its “pleasingly firm feel with just enough give” to soothe his achy back. It also comes with a 25-year warranty. Karen Yuan

Hair everywhere is the bane of every pet owner. If you have carpets and rugs, sometimes vacuums aren’t enough to remove stubborn follicles. Our expert recommends raking that hair up . The Uproot Clean Pro is a great way to get hair out of carpet loops without needing to bend down. (Also, for people who like to watch content on social media, this tool is super satisfying to watch.) Jon Chan

This Filter reader-favorite cashmere sweater comes in so many colors, plus in standard, petite and plus-sizes. Anthropologie’s sitewide sale takes 30% off, but several colors in this sweater are already selling out, so you better shop now. Carolin Lehmann

These PJs are made of an impossibly soft pima cotton, and the colors of this rainbow striped pair are just too cute. You can even add embroidery for an extra fee. Though they are slightly too short on me at 5ft 10in tall, nothing can stop me from reaching for them. You can enjoy 30% off sitewide through 1 Dec at Cozyland. Carolin Lehmann

If you want to feel like you’re wearing a knit blanket, go for this cozy jacket. It’s the perfect mid-weight coat that looks more expensive than it is. Barefoot Dreams has 30% off sitewide through 1 Dec. Carolin Lehmann

I can attest this cashmere T-shirt is never itchy – it feels super soft for layering. The tee looks instantly classy, and its heather cocoa color is so chic. Find 30% off sitewide at Naked Cashmere through the 30th. Carolin Lehmann

If you’re looking for a thick sweat set that will actually keep you warm, look no further. This duo in a pop of blue is pure comfort. Just note that I would size up in the sweatpants. Activewear brand LDMA has up to 50% off and Bogo underwear now, then up to 60% off and Bogo underwear on Cyber Monday. Carolin Lehmann

I own this adorable jacket, and it’s not only 62% off, but also part of Lulus’ buy one get one free sale . Blank NYC makes the most fun, high-quality coats, and this quilted fall option comes in a pretty vintage-inspired cream floral. Carolin Lehmann

This great sand colored zip-up is 35% off at Vici right now. Its contrast faux leather stitching looks super chic, and it’s been ideal for me to pop on during fall’s in-between weather. Carolin Lehmann

I received tons of compliments on this denim Paige set, which I wore on my birthday. It’s so flattering, and a matching set always makes you look like you have it all together. The jeans are great because they come in two lengths, plus they’re super soft and comfortable. Carolin Lehmann

This cheery 100% linen mini has teeny fish hanging off its ties and stunning embroidered scallops along the neckline. As the proud owner of this dress in another print, I can attest that Farm Rio never fails to overdeliver with the fun attention to detail. Carolin Lehmann

My Ugg minis are the classic version, but this on-sale stitched alternative is even cuter. These are so easy to throw on with any style of pants in the colder months, whether you’re running to pilates or walking in snowy conditions. Carolin Lehmann

The last time I used this anti-frizz styling cream that helps reduce breakage, someone specifically told me that my hair looked great that day. It makes your hair feel impossibly silky and even functions as a heat protectant. Don’t miss 30% off at Olaplex sitewide through 30 November. Carolin Lehmann

These pink sheet masks are a go-to in my fridge to depuff my face. They create a great base for my makeup thanks to their moisturizing formula. Carolin Lehmann

I love Phlur’s skin scents, and Golden Rule is a crowd-pleaser. Country star Kelsea Ballerini is known to wear it, and it has notes of mandarin, pink pepper and pear. You can get 20% off sitewide through the 30th at Phlur. Carolin Lehmann

Laneige’s Glaze Craze tinted lip serum in Cinnamon Sugar is the perfect brown fall color. I love to use it with a brown lip liner for my fall makeup looks, and it’s super moisturizing, smooth and not sticky on my lips. Laneige is offering 20% off skin products and 25% off lip products through the 30th. Carolin Lehmann

This perfect fall gourmand scent has notes of pistachio, almond and vanilla. I have the matching body wash and perfume as well. This cream has a unique texture that soaks into your skin quickly and feels impossibly luxurious. You can find 25% off sitewide at Sol de Janeiro through the 30th. Carolin Lehmann

This is one of my go-to products for bond repair. It literally seems to change the texture of my hair for the better. You can get 20% off sitewide with the promo code BF20 through the 30th at K18. This discount rises the more units you buy, up to 50% off. Carolin Lehmann

Oribe’s Gold Lust collection just feels luxurious. It has an expensive scent of citrus, florals and woods, and makes my hair look great every time. You can get 20% off a selection of bestsellers through the 30th at Oribe. Just add the items to your cart to see their sale price.

I’ve never met a MediHeal sheet mask I didn’t like, and this simple moisturizing hyaluronic acid one is a good place to start. I keep these sheet masks in my fridge to de-puff, and they give my skin the perfect smooth base for my makeup. Carolin Lehmann

This is probably my favorite makeup remover. It melts off makeup incredibly well (no raccoon eyes) and doesn’t glob on to my contact lenses as some other cleansing balms do. It’s also great for melting off stubborn sunscreen. You can get 25% off all orders, and 30% off orders of $100 and more, at Farmacy through 28 November. Carolin Lehmann

It’s almost spooky how this FDA-cleared microcurrent facial sculpting device instantly lifts your face. I’ve had it used on me during a facial, and I came out looking good as new. Through 2 December, you can enjoy 30% off site-wide, 40% off $500 and more and 50% off $750 and more at NuFace. Carolin Lehmann

“The Miracle Balm is one of my all-time favorite products, full-stop, because it works as a highlighter, bronzer, blush or even a tinted moisturizer,” wrote Tobey Grumet Segal in her guide to her favorite beauty products after turning 50 . It’s 15% off at Jones Road. Lauren Gould

Kosas already has its Black Friday sale going on with 25% off sitewide . If you don’t know where to start with the brand, may I suggest the Air Brow? Tinted brow gels are so hard to get right, and this one is my favorite. It doesn’t overdeposit product, and it holds your brows in place. When I’m in a rush, this is all I’ll use on my brows. Carolin Lehmann

If you own Apple devices, these are the headphones to beat. In his AirPods Pro 3 review , Guardian tech editor Samuel Gibbs said Apple’s best buds rival top over-ear headphones for active noise cancellation and audio quality, and improve “almost everything” compared with outgoing models. They even double as hearing aids . At $149, we haven’t seen them priced this low since last Black Friday. Quentyn Kennemer

The Filter’s pick for the best Bluetooth speaker overall is down to its lowest price in months. Audio expert Simon Cohen says this eccentric and rugged model delivers a rare, satisfying bass that you can feel. It resists water and dust, lasts 16 hours per charge (a bit lower than competitors) and can be synced with multiple Soundcore speakers. Quentyn Kennemer

The Guardian’s tech editor Samuel Gibbs called these the “best-sounding Beats yet” in his four-star review, and this is the lowest price we’ve ever seen for them. They last up to 40 hours per charge, and offer premium features like lossless USB-C audio, plus Apple perks like one-touch pairing and built-in Find My feature. Quentyn Kennemer

If you only make one upgrade to your home theater, make it a soundbar . With nine horizontal speakers, four upfiring speakers and even a subwoofer built in, tech expert Ryan Waniata calls this Sonos “the ultimate one-piece soundbar”. This is the biggest discount we’ve seen on it since last Black Friday. Quentyn Kennemer

Not sold on the iPhone Duo ? The Guardian’s tech reviewer Samuel Gibbs called the Galaxy Z Fold 8 “another stunning piece of technology from Samsung” in his four-star review . It’s also thinner, lighter, offers more comprehensive multitasking and foldable app support, and at this price, clearly a better value. Quentyn Kennemer

Apple’s most affordable MacBook gets its steepest discount yet, dropping to its original launch price for the first time since memory shortages drove costs up . The MacBook Neo uses an iPhone chip, but “proves cheaper machines don’t have to be rubbish,” said Guardian tech editor Sam Gibbs in his review . It’s ideal for anyone who needs a lightweight laptop for casual browsing, work and fun. Quentyn Kennemer

This 24in monitor, an honorable mention in our work-from-home upgrade guide , packs surprising substance for an all-time-low price. The LCD display is 1080p resolution, but the IPS panel maximizes color accuracy, sharpness and viewing angles at this size. Its 180Hz refresh rate enables smooth high-frame rate gaming, along with premium features like HDR and adaptive sync. Quentyn Kennemer

Apple AirTags only work with Apple devices, but our tech experts say “tile trackers are the next best thing” for Android users who need help locating everyday items. These let you view their last known location on your phone and can make a sound within a reasonable distance. Each tracker has a keyring for attaching to your bag. If you use iPhone, AirTags are also $23 on Amazon , about as cheap as they’ve ever been. Quentyn Kennemer

This is the biggest discount we’ve seen yet on Apple’s newest MacBook Pro, which was completely redesigned with an OLED touchscreen that incorporates iPhone’s Dynamic Island feature. “The reduced weight, slimmer body and absolutely stunning new screen are meaningful upgrades,” wrote tech editor Sam Gibbs in his review . It also has new speakers with an M5 Pro chip matching the power of previous models. Quentyn Kennemer

It’s pricey even with this historically low discount, but the Scribe should last many years. It holds thousands of ebooks, Kindle or otherwise, and lets you write notes within those books or on empty pages in a digital notebooks. “The writing experience on the Scribe is shockingly good,” wrote the Guardian’s tech editor Samuel Gibbs in our Kindle Scribe review . To him, it felt like the closest thing to writing on actual paper. To learn about e-readers, check out our Best ebook readers guide. Quentyn Kennemer

A go-to toiletry case for all your mini products and TSA-sized travel bottles streamlines the packing process and gives you one less thing to think about before a trip. I’d recommend Leatherology’s Small Train Case. The roomy design organizes all your essentials into six interior pockets, and the lining resists the inevitable splashes and spills. Lydia Mansel

Traveling carry-on-only is infinitely easier with the right suitcase. The Filter-tested TravelPro Platinum Elite Carry-On Hardside Spinner is a smart, stylish option armed with design features that any traveler will appreciate. The polycarbonate hard shell is highly durable, the interior zippered pockets help with organization, and the built-in TSA lock keeps the contents secure in transit. Lydia Mansel

I’ve been using BAGAIL packing cubes for six years – and I see no need to replace them. While these aren’t compression cubes, they do serve a very important purpose: organization. I like to separate my clothing by type and pack them in different cubes (this particular set comes with nine, all in various sizes). Bagail’s compression version also won best budget pick in our packing cubes test , and this set of four is now on sale . Lydia Mansel

Preparing my travel pouches is one of the most important steps of my packing process – snacks usually go in one, electronics and cords in another. Lately, the Cuyana Voyager Travel Case has been my most-used style. It’s spacious without becoming overly bulky, and the leather can be wiped clean as necessary. Lydia Mansel

The perfect weekender bag is tough to nail; it has to be spacious without being overly bulky, it should have organizational features, and it ideally packs down small when not in use. Calpak nailed it with the Luka Duffel, though. Pro tip: Stash it in your suitcase if you plan on doing some shopping during your trip. Lydia Mansel

Business travelers – or anyone who never boards a plane without their laptop – should seriously consider the Lo & Sons Rowledge 2 Laptop Backpack. The sleek bag can be carried as either a briefcase or a backpack, and it’s outfitted with plenty of storage features (a laptop compartment, a separate shoe compartment, and all manner of interior pockets). Lydia Mansel

The Cotopaxi Allpa 42L Travel Pack earned its place as my 2026 MVP on a three-week trip across Africa. Not only can it fit five to seven days’ worth of clothing, but it also has a padded laptop sleeve, a water bottle pocket, and three nifty interior pockets. The comfortable shoulder straps are the cherry on top. Lydia Mansel

Traveling to a European country this winter? Leave the puffer jacket at home. Instead, you need a stylish wool coat to complete your look, and I’d go with the Madewell Simone Cocoon Coat. The oversized silhouette lets you layer as needed, and the convertible funnel-neck collar adds extra protection from the chill. Lydia Mansel

A travel power adapter might not be super glamorous, but it’s incredibly necessary to keep all your devices powered up abroad. This Anker version is a favorite among the Filter US team for a design that’s more compact than most, yet still works in more than 200 countries and provides four USB ports. Lydia Mansel

In the market for a bag small enough to carry aboard as a personal item? I have several bags from Cuyana, including the Tall Easy Zipper Tote, and I turn to them again and again when I travel. This style is a business traveler’s dream – it fits a 16-inch laptop and can be carried by shoulder straps or long handles. Lydia Mansel

Before I discovered the versatile, surprisingly spacious Terra, I refused to travel with a backpack. It opens like a clamshell, so you pack it like a regular suitcase, but you can carry it as either a backpack or duffel. It’s the ideal bag for a weekend getaway. Lydia Mansel

Named the best compression packing cube by the Filter US team after testing 26 models, the Thule Compression Packing Cube is a must-have for any overpacker. The compression zipper system smushes down bulkier pieces – like chunky sweaters – allowing for a better fit in your suitcase. Semitransparent material also lets you see what’s inside without unzipping it. Lydia Mansel

While relatively pricey, the Carl Friedrik Granville Weekender is a bag you’ll use for many years to come. With a 33-liter capacity, it’s more spacious than the svelte design appears, comfortably holding everything you need for a three- or four-day trip. Lydia Mansel

For me, winter is synonymous with ski trips – and base layers are always the first addition to my suitcase. This season, I’m packing the 100% wool Kari Traa Smekker Half-Zip Base Layer Top. It’s lightweight, breathable, odor-resistant and it’s cute enough for any après-ski activities. Lydia Mansel

Packing sunscreen is one of my travel grievances. I’m usually carry-on-only, so I can’t bring full-size bottles. This year, however, I realized a sun shirt, like this one from IUGA, cuts down on how much sunscreen I need. Whether I’m headed to the Galápagos or somewhere in the Caribbean, it’s one of the first things I pack. Lydia Mansel

Whenever I’m asked about the best carry-on suitcases , I always recommend the Away Bigger Carry-On Flex, particularly for overpackers. It’s roomy, durable, and always passes the sit-and-zip test whenever I’ve gone overboard with clothes. Go for the bright colorways and you’ll never lose it in a crowd. While I’d happily pay full price for this specific carry-on, it’s currently 25% off, which saves you nearly $100. Lydia Mansel

I’ve been on eight flights more than 15 hours long this year alone, so I know a thing or two about in-flight essentials. The Trtl Pillow Plus is, hands down, my must-have for any red-eye. The adjustable built-in neck support system means I wake up pain-free, even after nodding off for a full eight hours of sleep. Lydia Mansel

Named one of the best personal-item backpacks by the Filter US team, the Bellroy Lite Travel Pack 30L Carry-On Travel Backpack is the definition of a frequent-flyer essential. It may be compact, but it doesn’t skimp on function, with loads of exterior and interior pockets, built-in packing cells, and a separate pocket that fits a 16in laptop. Lydia Mansel

Compression socks are another accessory I won’t hop on a long-haul flight without. While I was skeptical of them at first, my legs and feet feel infinitely fresher after I get off the plane, and I don’t feel as restless while I’m in my seat. These Comrad compression socks, which provide 15-20 mmHg compression, were named the best compression socks for travel by the Filter US – so grab them while they’re on sale. Lydia Mansel

AirTags are the perfect gift for the traveler in your life, but I’d also snag a few for yourself while this 4-pack is $20 off. Put one in your suitcase, your wallet and your purse. The next time your luggage goes missing, or you misplace your wallet, all you have to do is open up the Find My app on your iPhone. You’ll be able to instantly track down their respective locations. Lydia Mansel

If you need to rehaul your luggage lineup, go with a cost-saving set. The Roam Long Weekend Set, which comes with a carry-on and check-in bag, checks all the boxes: 360-degree spinner wheels, water-resistant zippers, a zippered interior pocket, and a removable hanging-organizer compression board. Plus, complimentary monogramming. Lydia Mansel

$15 $23 at Amazon A luggage scale is one of my packing “hacks.” It saves me the stress and anticipation of weighing my bag at the airport - only to realize I have to take out a few items to stay under the weight limit. This particular scale is rechargeable, so you don’t have to deal with a dead battery the night before a trip. Lydia Mansel

I’ve spent nearly 20 days on safari this year, and the Nomatic McKinnon Camera Sling 8L has been my partner in crime on every game drive. The structured bag keeps my two cameras secure and still has room for other essentials (including sunscreen and lip balm). I especially appreciate how the internal Velcro divider storage system is customizable. Lydia Mansel

When it comes to a travel uniform, I believe in quality over quantity. You only need a few comfortable, versatile staples you can pack on repeat. The North Face Women’s Jaida Crew is one of mine. The sweatshirt is slightly cropped, which keeps it from looking messy, and it’s oversized enough that it can be worn as an extra layer. Lydia Mansel

I rarely board a plane without the organic cotton zestt Dreamsoft Travel Scarf – and I fly anywhere from two to four times a month. I pack it in my personal item, so when I get chilly, I have a simple solution. Right now, it’s $25 off (but it does dip to this price a few times a year). Lydia Mansel

This is my favorite travel find of 2026. The discount is modest, but it’s the lowest price they’ve been all year. I use these micellar wipes on long flights and after particularly grueling travel days. The excess product doesn’t need to be washed off, and the wipes leave my dry skin feeling incredibly clean and hydrated. Lydia Mansel

As a solo female traveler, I take a few safety precautions when I’m on a trip. No matter where I go, the Birdie 3.0 Safety Alarm – on sale for 25% off right now – is attached to my keys. It features a strobe light and a siren designed to startle unsavory encounters; you just have to pull the top ring. Lydia Mansel

This warm and stretchy jacket got a mention in our roundup of versatile fall apparel . My husband loves the Overlook Primaloft jacket for cool-weather hikes, and praises its tough fabric, easy packability, and casual look that goes with any outfit. Paige Triola

This trail shoe is renowned for being comfortable over many hours of running, thanks in part to its wide toebox and rugged outsole that protects the foot from pointy rocks. I’ve conquered multiple trail races in this shoe and keep it handy for both runs and technical hikes. Paige Triola

Included in our list of essential exercise products , this streamlined running belt is a must. It’s stretchy enough to hold a phone, keys and wallet. The best part: no bouncing. We spotted some on NYC marathoners , too. Paige Triola

With clear lids to reveal their contents and gaskets to seal out dust and water, these rugged outdoor storage bins solve everything you hate about cheap totes. I regularly use them to organize everything from snacks to snowboard boots on outdoor adventures. Paige Triola

A warm and comfy slipper feels like a luxury on camping trips, and this Teva model is one I’d recommend for its sturdy outsole and insulating upper. I love how quickly it slips on so I can go from the tent to the campfire without needing to fiddle with laces. Paige Triola

This versatile water shoe felt great from the first wear, which was a 4-mile hike traversing both rocky ground and stream crossings. I love how light and breathable it is, which makes it dry quickly. Paige Triola

The toughest socks I own have seen me through long hikes. Aside from this excellent pair that is now half off, the brand that sources its merino wool entirely from US farmers is running up to 50% off sitewide with free shipping. Paige Triola

Despite its light weight, this wool hooded sweatshirt is excellent at retaining warmth. In true Merino wool fashion, the top also remains odor-free even after multiple wears, making it ideal for multi-day outdoor adventures. The 25% off sitewide discount is Ridge Merino’s biggest sale of the year. Paige Triola

This roomy two-person camp chair got a shout out in our list of thoughtful wedding gifts .I like this Kelty bestseller for marshmallow roasting by the campfire and back-yard get-togethers. If you’re a fan of the brand, there are many other Kelty products discounted this week. For more chair ideas, we also have a best camping chairs guide (we may add this model in a future update). Paige Triola .

This compact, reasonably priced treadmill was a gamechanger for my home gym setup: owning a treadmill felt like an unattainable dream because of the size and cost – this model solves both of those problems. The running platform folds up when not in use, making it ideal for small spaces. Paige Triola

This outdoor game is a fun alternative to standard lawn games like cornhole or horseshoes. I gifted it to my mother-in-law, an avid golfer, and found it to be a family-friendly activity that gets everyone out of the house. This is the lowest price it will be during the holidays. Paige Triola

In our gift ideas for skiers guide , I liked the Daylite 26+6 backpack for holding extra gear, but I also uses the matching Daylite Wheeled Duffel for adventure travel. Lightweight and sturdy, this rolling duffel is collapsible, allowing it to be easily stored when not in use. This discount started in September, but it’s still a remarkably good deal for a bag that was $325 all year before that, and $295 last year. Paige Triola

As noted in our Essential exercise products guide , this red-light pad uses 216 medical-grade LEDs to aid your workout recovery. I reported noticeably fewer aches and inflammation when doing 20-minute Novaa Light Pad sessions after exercise. This is the lowest price we’ve seen on it this year. To learn more about red-light therapy, read our red-light explainer . Paige Triola

If you want to browse more Black Friday 2026 deals yourself, the links below lead directly to each leading retailer’s holiday deals homepage. Check out our many buying guides and holiday gift guides for more ideas.

We work for our readers, rather than the brands we write about. Every item we recommend is something a Filter editor or contributor has personally tested and can vouch for unless stated otherwise. On occasion, we may present a close substitute from the same brand and explain any differences from the original.

We scour competing retailers for the lowest prices on any item, and we use price-tracking tools such as Camelcamelcamel to check price history and ensure the discounts are truly good value, rather than a faux markdown. (So while we love sharing good deals, we also aren’t afraid to call out the unimpressive ones.)

Our mission is to help you filter out junk products and buy fewer, better things.

At the Filter US , we test the products we recommend ourselves and never take your trust for granted. We also consider possible impacts on your health or the environment in our coverage and companies cannot buy a spot in our product rankings because we are here to serve you, not corporations.

Our dedicated testing, editing and production teams are based across the United States and Canada. We are a part of the Guardian’s US editorial team and our journalists follow its strict ethical standards. Learn more about us here .
paragraphs: You’ll find countless deals on Black Friday, but our editors have narrowed the list down to the very few worth your time
Visit our ultimate guide to Black Friday for more deals, carefully vetted and curated by Filter US editors
Some Black Friday sales are modest markdowns not worth your time, while others will save you hundreds on the buy-it-for-life mattress or vacuum cleaner you’ve been considering.

To cut through the noise, our expert product reviewers judged thousands of Black Friday discounts across home, tech, kitchen, fashion and more. Here are the ones we’d grab, on products we’ve personally tested and love.

We test products here at the Filter US and handpicked these deals. You can learn more about us at the bottom of the list. Products marked ( sold out ) are out of stock or no longer discounted. All prices are current at the time of publication. We’ll update our guides throughout Black Friday.

Everyone always needs more food storage containers (nothing makes you understand that better than Thanksgiving) and this Rubbermaid set once passed a drop test I conducted with flying colors. These sturdy containers seal well, and come in a variety of convenient sizes for sauce and leftover storage. Replace those old, weathered plastic containers at a serious discount. Emily Johnson

$23 $30 at Amazon While the Stanley cup is great for encouraging hydration at home or by your desk, it’s not easy to take on the road. Owala makes my favorite portable water bottle: Its design is simply unparalleled. The opening at the top of the water bottle functions seamlessly as both a sippable option and as a straw. This water bottle has never leaked on me, it feels pleasant in hand, and I want it in every fun color it comes in. Emily Johnson

That oven isn’t the only deal you can score at Our Place, which is offering up to 45% off sitewide. These stylish glasses come in three fun colors (in addition to the classic clear version) and are conveniently stackable. And – as I can attest to – are durable even if you have a slippery hand after a negroni or two. Emily Johnson

In my review , I wrote that this indulgent, self-heating ceramic mug “ruined all other mugs for me.” Now 20% off, this handsome ceramic cup keeps drinks toasty at 130F, while its warming pad doubles as a wireless phone charger. It hasn’t left my work-from-home station since the chilly weather has set in. Karen Yuan

I own Material’s steak knife set at home and has put these knives through the ringer of pork chops, dense starchy vegetables and, of course, steaks. They are sharp, precise and balanced. They offer a subtle stylishness that’s also neutral and universally appealing. Snag them for 20% off now. Emily Johnson

All-Clad is the original creator of bonded stainless steel cookware – and it is an enduring and beloved classic for a reason. Its cookware heats evenly and, with proper care, will last a lifetime. In the leadup to this Black Friday, you can get a 10-piece set featuring 8in and 10in fry pans, 2qt and 4qt saucepans with lids, a 4qt saute pan with a lid, and an 8qt stockpot with a lid, for $200 off. It’s still spendy, but it’s an investment that will pay dividends for ever. Emily Johnson

After spending my summer cooking with tinned fish, I named Fishwife’s options as some of the best. I used its soy ginger tuna to make onigiri and the chimichurri trout to craft an artful snack plate. If you’re beginning your tinned fish journey, its variety pack has both of those cans at 20% off. Lauren Gould

If you’re working with a smaller space and can’t accommodate a whole 10-piece cookware set, opt for this set of two stellar stainless-steel pans for $150 off. Both pans feature 5-ply bonding that makes for a combination of long-lasting sturdiness and even heating. The 8.5in size is excellent for soft scrambled eggs for one or two, while the 10.5in will come in handy for a whole host of standard cooking tasks, like caramelizing onions, browning chicken cutlets and whisking creamy pan sauces. Emily Johnson

Zojirushi is the central player in the rice cooker game for a reason: their precision heating tech is unrivaled and leads to fluffy, perfectly-cooked grains every time. Upgrade this staple appliance for over a $100 discount this Black Friday. Emily Johnson

A friend keeps ice cube trays full of caramelized onions in the freezer, ready to pop into soups, sandwiches, pastas and grain bowls for easy depth of flavor. So I bought these Anytime Freezer Trays for expressly that purpose and they’ve changed my meal-prep game: the rounded shape and silicone material make for easy removal. Plus, there’s no polluting my ice cube trays with onion flavor. I have instant flavor boosters at the ready at all times. Get them for 22% off now. Emily Johnson

We’re huge fans of Anyday’s colorful, leak-resistant silicone containers, which make storing and reheating leftovers a breeze. They’re microwave-, freezer- and dishwasher-safe, and this six-pack is now at its lowest price ever. Read our full rave review . Karen Yuan

In our review of Magnifique’s combo air fryer , we loved its glass construction, which does away with the usual nonstick-coated basket. This handsome standalone air fryer uses the same appealing materials, and at $128, it’s enjoying its biggest sale since launch. Karen Yuan

Our editors love these stretchy silicone lids for covering everything from bowls of soup and salad to opened drink cans. They’re durable, safe to pop in the dishwasher and endlessly useful. At 35% off, now’s a great time to stock up (right before the holiday leftover crush). Karen Yuan

This cult favorite pink paste is a superhero for tackling stubborn kitchen grime, from greasy stovetops to stained sinks. It’ll get at your bathroom grout, too. At just $3, it’s a satisfyingly cheap cleaning upgrade. Karen Yuan

We love a Le Creuset deal, especially when it involves this gorgeous lavender-hued Dutch oven. It’s perfect for searing, braising and simmering, and Sur La Table’s exclusive Provence shade is particularly pretty. It makes a great gift, too. Karen Yuan

On a cold, dreary day, I like lighting Flamingo Estate’s Green Goddess candle in my kitchen, which instantly recalls a summery vegetable garden. It smells strongly of fresh mint, rounded out by notes of basil, sweet peas and even bell pepper. It also has an incredible throw – meaning how far and strongly a fragrance travels – filling my entire apartment from the kitchen. Fifty-four dollars is still a lot, but this “bougie candle” (as inscribed on the label) is one of the very best. Karen Yuan

Wood is my favorite material for cutting boards, but I like to have a few low-maintenance, lightweight options around as supplements. These Material Free Boards are made out of a plant-based alternative to plastic, but still offer the same convenience. We named it best for raw meat in our review, and you can throw them in the dishwasher. Get a couple in their fun colorways for 25% off now. Emily Johnson

You probably know by now: Vitamix blenders are the best in the business . This thing boasts a two-horsepower motor that can crush nuts into milk or butter and pulverise ice into shreds for frozen drinks. In my years of using this blender, I’ve found the 5200 is the best model the brand makes, with plenty of power, variable speed and a 64-ounce container that’s optimal for most blending jobs. Score this $200 off deal and enjoy creamy soups for years to come. Emily Johnson

Every home cook dreams of owning a KitchenAid stand mixer, and this holiday season you can score the brand’s Artisan series tilt-head classic for $100 off. Snag it as a gift for the college grad setting up a new home, or the relative who suddenly got into baking this year. Emily Johnson

Breville makes espresso machines for discerning coffee lovers who may not want to go the full lengths of nerding out. The machines feature automations that make pulling a velvety, delicious shot fool-proof even for beginners. It’s the perfect gift for someone who has resolved to cut down their coffee shop trips this year - this thing pays for itself quickly, especially at a $200 discount this Black Friday. Emily Johnson

Ninja makes air fryers with more bells and whistles , but I like this simple basket-style model; it’s easy to operate right out of the box, and its powerful convection fan has always given me crispy fries and vegetables. Plus, it toasts bread and reheats pizza with aplomb. It’s the perfect size for cooking for one or two people - just be mindful to not overload the basket, since each food item needs space to allow the hot air circulation to work its crisping magic. Emily Johnson

Over years of testing sous vide machines, I’ve found that the Joule boasts the very best accuracy — which is the name of the game with sous vide. I love its streamlined design and while I’m often skeptical of appliances that link to smart phone apps, this one is genuinely useful: It features helpful temperature and cooking guides and offers convenient remote operation. Emily Johnson

This is an absolute cornucopia of holiday treats. The lavish spread feeds 12 to 15 with artisan cheeses, truffle salami, chorizo, candied nuts, dried fruits, chocolates, crackers, and four decadent baked bries. For Black Friday, you can get $50 off plus free honeycomb. (If you have leftovers, our editors love these charcuterie board-friendly storage containers , though they aren’t on sale.) Karen Yuan

Instant’s Duo represents its most classic multi-cooker model - and it’s my favorite after using nearly every model in the line - with all of the features you want in an electric multi-cooker and nothing more. Its settings include pressure cooking, slow cooking, rice cooking, yogurt making, steaming, sautéing and warming. You can get one for just $60 on Amazon right now, just in time for cozy braising and stewing season. Emily Johnson

Every home cook needs a good 3qt saucepan for making small batches of soup, individual portions of mac and cheese, and many, many sauces. Misen’s 3qt saucier features gently sloped sides, which means that a whisk can easily reach into the corners of a pan for a perfectly emulsified pan sauce. It boasts 5-ply stainless steel construction for sturdiness and even heating, and comes with a lid. Get it for 25% off on Black Friday. Emily Johnson

I’ve tested chef’s knives for years, and have long appreciated Misen’s balanced and fairly priced option – and now it’s available for an even more reasonable 25% off. This is a great knife if you want to strike a balance between the heft of a German-style knife and the easily maneuverable precision of a Japanese knife. Emily Johnson

I also recommended a $100 Cuisinart air fryer/toaster oven , and I stand by that budget pick with serious versatility and crisping power. For those looking to upgrade, Breville’s countertop ovens are expensive but unmatched. This one dehydrates, air fries (AKA cooks with convection), broils and does regular roasting beautifully. You can cook a whole dinner in it, or simply make an evenly-browned piece of toast. Emily Johnson

Fly By Jing’s condiments make perfect stocking stuffers for anyone on your list who loves to cook. This sampler gift set features three chili crisps: the brand’s original hot and numbing blend, one that’s extra spicy and one that emphasizes umami and texture (AKA less chili, more crunch). You also get a chili sauce that’s sweet, tangy and spicy, inspired by Zhong dumplings, popular in Chengdu. Emily Johnson

I love this Ninja air fryer , but I also think that a combined air fryer and toaster oven is better bang for your buck and offers more versatility. This Cuisinart has performed consistently in my years of testing air fryers and convection toaster ovens, with optimal hot air circulation for even cooking and crispy edges. The larger capacity of the toaster oven means it’s better for larger families - it’s even possible to roast a whole chicken in this guy. Emily Johnson

SMEG’s retro futurist design adds whimsy to any kitchen, but this kettle isn’t all good looks. It boasts 1400 watts of power and can boil water in four minutes or less. It’s comfortable to hold and steady to pour from. This is a great all-around kettle for getting a head start on boiling water for pasta, making tea or hot cocoa, cleaning a sink drain, and preheating mugs. Emily Johnson

Say what you want about the Stanley cup trend, which has largely come and gone anyway, but anything that promotes hydration can’t be all that bad. The cup is available at a hefty discount in all kinds of fun colors right now - I love the cheery daffodil - so snag a few for the people on your list who need to drink more water (that’s probably all of them). Emily Johnson

This drip coffee maker is beloved by coffee snobs and professionals the world over thanks to its superior shower head design, which distributes hot water evenly over the coffee grounds. This leads to superior flavor extraction and a balanced cup. I love its chic industrial look and all of the color options. As with the Stanley cup , I’m coveting the butter yellow - a pattern is emerging here. Emily Johnson

Coffee nerds, this is the kettle for you. If you make pour-over, Stagg’s gooseneck kettle allows you to delicately and evenly disperse water over the grounds for a balanced and flavorful extraction. It has precise temperature controls and has no plastic touching the hot water. Yes, it’s a splurge even at a deal, but this kettle is the very best of its kind and will make a noticeable difference in the quality of your morning brew. Emily Johnson

I’m a big fan of the sleek design on Zwilling’s Enfinigy line (I also own the personal blender). But that sleek look would be nothing if this toaster didn’t produce evenly-browned, golden slices of bread. Luckily it does just that. In a world full of multi-use, souped-up appliances, sometimes you just want a simple thing that will toast bread well. This is a great option, at a great discount. Emily Johnson

Don’t buy the Ooni as a Christmas gift for anyone who isn’t willing to commit the hours to learning how to finesse the pizza from the oven to the peel. For someone who wants to nerd out, though, this is the deal of the century on a piece of equipment that has made all of my outdoor summer parties infinitely better and more delicious. Ooni also makes one of our favorite indoor pizza ovens , the Volt 2, currently 20% off . Emily Johnson

In my experience testing air purifiers , people are often surprised by the cost of an air purifier big enough to purify a whole floor of a house – it’s often up to triple the price of a one-room purifier. That’s why this sale on the Coway 250S I’ve tested previously caught my eye. It can cover 1,860 sq ft, and has an easily accessible and cleanable pre-filter mesh, the part that catches large debris like pet hair. Its activated carbon filter helps remove odors, and a Hepa filter reduces fine particulates. Jon Chan

Washer-dryer combos have come a long way in the past few years. This GE model is the prime example. If you have a water hookup, a drain pipe and a 120V outlet, you can do laundry. No exhaust vent needed. When we spent hands-on time with this machine, we enjoyed the automatic detergent dispenser, the Microban-injected gasket that prevents odors, and the 4.8-cubic-ft capacity. Jon Chan

So you want the ergonomic convenience of an upright vacuum while cleaning the floor, but hate cleaning the stairs with it? The Shark Vertex Lift-Away NV752 can be lifted off its wheeled base and used with a hose, allowing you to more easily clean tight spaces like your car and the stairs. The brush head can clean hardwood and carpet, and you can select between these two modes with a flick of a switch on the handle. We cleaned with this system before and found it great at removing debris, fine dust and pet hair. Jon Chan

Turn your pilling sweaters from bleak to chic with this battery-powered fabric shaver. Keeping your clothing in good condition for longer is a great way to save money and reduce waste. Aside from the price, we also like that shavings are stored in an easily emptied chamber. Jon Chan

Bubble blankets are huge on social media. One issue is that they tend to be super expensive. However, our investigations show that Bedsure makes a throw that is just as soft and cozy as the high-end brands at a fraction of the cost. This throw isn’t quite large enough for a bed, but perfect for cuddling on the couch. Jon Chan
Many quality tool companies, like DeWalt, often sell drills without a battery. This deal bundle comes with a battery that’s swappable, giving access to the whole DeWalt cordless collection. Jon Chan

Tech deals tend to get the spotlight on Black Friday, but it’s also a good time to stock up on pantry items and household essentials. Toilet paper might not be glamorous, but this is a chance to get the premium stuff for the same price as its cheaper peers. Jon Chan

This robot vacuum-mop combo comes with a detachable carpet cleaner. Our reviewer found it to be a secret weapon against spills and stains . Jon Chan

How do you know when you’ve missed a spot? The Dyson V15 Detect uses an angled green laser that illuminates fine dust and dirt on hardwood floors. This small-but-mighty carpet cleaner has a cult following, and after using it, we can see why. It’s powerful for its exceptionally compact size, and easy to use. This capacious French door fridge is perfect for anyone who loves hosting. Speaking of drinks, it can also produce spherical ice, ideal for keeping cocktails cold without watering them down, and a built-in water pitcher that refills itself with filtered water. Jon Chan

If you sit working most of the day, investing in an ergonomic office chair is 100% worth it. Aeron is the pinnacle of chair technology. Everything from the armrests, seat angle and spine support are adjustable to nearly every body type. Plus, the mesh backing helps prevent heat buildup. Jon Chan

Slightly cheaper per battery than on Amazon. Batteries are a staple, especially since so many holiday gifts don’t include them. Now is the best time to stock up and save a little money. Just think of all the things in your house that will need a change in AA batteries in the coming year. Jon Chan

Everyone owns towels, but these exceptionally plush ones are a great way to add a little luxury to your daily routine. Stop putting off organizing your garage or basement with this exceptionally low price on heavy-duty steel shelving from Lowe’s. One of the worst things about an alarm clock is how … alarming they can be. The Loftie solves this problem by waking you up in two phases. You can even set the clock itself to be less distracting by dimming it to black at night. It’s backed by so much sleep science that it’s HSA-eligible. Jon Chan

Just look at how much this cat loves this mattress topper ! We love it for its luxurious feel and the baffle-box design that prevents bunching. If you’re looking for an affordable way to make your mattress softer and cozier, check out this mattress topper for 25% off. Jon Chan

If you’re on the fence about weighted blankets, you should check out the YnM 15-Pound. It’s not the most luxurious, but it is super affordable. Jon Chan

A warm and comfy slipper feels like a luxury on camping trips, and this Teva model is one I’d recommend for its sturdy outsole and insulating upper. I love how quickly it slips on so I can go from the tent to the campfire without needing to fiddle with laces. Paige Triola

This versatile water shoe felt great from the first wear, which was a 4-mile hike traversing both rocky ground and stream crossings. I love how light and breathable it is, which makes it dry quickly. Paige Triola

The toughest socks I own have seen me through long hikes. Aside from this excellent pair that is now half off, the brand that sources its merino wool entirely from US farmers is running up to 50% off sitewide with free shipping. Paige Triola

Despite its light weight, this wool hooded sweatshirt is excellent at retaining warmth. In true Merino wool fashion, the top also remains odor-free even after multiple wears, making it ideal for multi-day outdoor adventures. The 25% off sitewide discount is Ridge Merino’s biggest sale of the year. Paige Triola

This roomy two-person camp chair got a shout out in our list of thoughtful wedding gifts .I like this Kelty bestseller for marshmallow roasting by the campfire and back-yard get-togethers. If you’re a fan of the brand, there are many other Kelty products discounted this week. For more chair ideas, we also have a best camping chairs guide (we may add this model in a future update). Paige Triola .

This compact, reasonably priced treadmill was a gamechanger for my home gym setup: owning a treadmill felt like an unattainable dream because of the size and cost – this model solves both of those problems. The running platform folds up when not in use, making it ideal for small spaces. Paige Triola

This outdoor game is a fun alternative to standard lawn games like cornhole or horseshoes. I gifted it to my mother-in-law, an avid golfer, and found it to be a family-friendly activity that gets everyone out of the house. This is the lowest price it will be during the holidays. Paige Triola

In our gift ideas for skiers guide , I liked the Daylite 26+6 backpack for holding extra gear, but I also uses the matching Daylite Wheeled Duffel for adventure travel. Lightweight and sturdy, this rolling duffel is collapsible, allowing it to be easily stored when not in use. This discount started in September, but it’s still a remarkably good deal for a bag that was $325 all year before that, and $295 last year. Paige Triola

As noted in our Essential exercise products guide , this red-light pad uses 216 medical-grade LEDs to aid your workout recovery. I reported noticeably fewer aches and inflammation when doing 20-minute Novaa Light Pad sessions after exercise. This is the lowest price we’ve seen on it this year. To learn more about red-light therapy, read our red-light explainer . Paige Triola

If you want to browse more Black Friday 2026 deals yourself, the links below lead directly to each leading retailer’s holiday deals homepage. Check out our many buying guides and holiday gift guides for more ideas.

We work for our readers, rather than the brands we write about. Every item we recommend is something a Filter editor or contributor has personally tested and can vouch for unless stated otherwise. On occasion, we may present a close substitute from the same brand and explain any differences from the original.

We scour competing retailers for the lowest prices on any item, and we use price-tracking tools such as Camelcamelcamel to check price history and ensure the discounts are truly good value, rather than a faux markdown. (So while we love sharing good deals, we also aren’t afraid to call out the unimpressive ones.)
Our mission is to help you filter out junk products and buy fewer, better things.

At the Filter US , we test the products we recommend ourselves and never take your trust for granted. We also consider possible impacts on your health or the environment in our coverage and companies cannot buy a spot in our product rankings because we are here to serve you, not corporations.

Our dedicated testing, editing and production teams are based across the United States and Canada. We are a part of the Guardian’s US editorial team and our journalists follow its strict ethical standards. Learn more about us here .
